checks.note: PCGen: the companion kit's STAT line plus the race row's BONUS:STAT.

companionReview.companionCalculation: The sheet calculates animal companion progression (#325) for the representative wolf and horse only; other species' statistics, sizes, attacks and advancement are not calculated (#326 and later). This resource supplies no Modifier.

prerequisiteReview.review: A companion actor has no selection prerequisite; the druid level at which it may be chosen or advances is a companion progression fact (statBlock.advancementLevel), not a prerequisite atom.

proficiencyReview.review: No weapon or armor proficiency grant in this record.

outstandingCalculations: The companion's starting statistics, size, speeds, senses, natural attacks and its advancement are not calculated from this resource: the #325 progression covers the representative wolf and horse only, and retaining the stat block (details.notes) does not interpret it.

checks.note: PCGen: the companion kit's STAT line plus the race row's BONUS:STAT.

PCGen's advancement row states only the adjustments beyond the size change (BONUS:STAT); the size change's own adjustments come from the PCGen game mode, outside the pinned data set, so the total is not compared. residualForSizeChange is the pinned total less PCGen's explicit adjustments.

companionReview.companionCalculation: The sheet calculates animal companion progression (#325) for the representative wolf and horse only; other species' statistics, sizes, attacks and advancement are not calculated (#326 and later). This resource supplies no Modifier.

prerequisiteReview.review: A companion actor has no selection prerequisite; the druid level at which it may be chosen or advances is a companion progression fact (statBlock.advancementLevel), not a prerequisite atom.

proficiencyReview.review: No weapon or armor proficiency grant in this record.

outstandingCalculations: The companion's starting statistics, size, speeds, senses, natural attacks and its advancement are not calculated from this resource: the #325 progression covers the representative wolf and horse only, and retaining the stat block (details.notes) does not interpret it.
